user.title: Gree Climate Setup
user.description: Choose how to add your Gree air conditioner

discovery.title: Discovered Devices
discovery.description: Found {devices_found} Gree device(s). Select one to add or choose manual setup.

detect_encryption.title: Configure Device
detect_encryption.description: Device connection successful. Enter a name for this device.

manual.title: Manual Setup
manual.description: Enter the details for your Gree air conditioner

target_temp_step.name: Temperature Step
target_temp_step.description: Sets the increment step for adjusting the target temperature.

preset_home_heat.name: Home - Heat Temperature
preset_home_heat.description: Target temperature for Home preset in heating mode.

preset_home_cool.name: Home - Cool Temperature
preset_home_cool.description: Target temperature for Home preset in cooling mode.

preset_sleep_heat.name: Sleep - Heat Temperature
preset_sleep_heat.description: Target temperature for Sleep preset in heating mode.

preset_sleep_cool.name: Sleep - Cool Temperature
preset_sleep_cool.description: Target temperature for Sleep preset in cooling mode.

preset_away_heat.name: Away - Heat Temperature
preset_away_heat.description: Target temperature for Away preset in heating mode.

preset_away_cool.name: Away - Cool Temperature
preset_away_cool.description: Target temperature for Away preset in cooling mode.

target_tolerance.name: Target Tolerance (±)
target_tolerance.description: Temperature band for target satisfaction (target reached). Used by cycle management to determine when unit can turn off. NOT used for idle detection (compressor state).

stht_smart_threshold_minutes.name: Smart 8°C Threshold
stht_smart_threshold_minutes.description: How long the Away or Sleep preset must be active in heating mode before Smart 8°C mode automatically engages frost protection.

external_temperature_sensor.name: External Temperature Sensor
external_temperature_sensor.description: Select a temperature sensor entity to use instead of the built-in AC sensor. Choose 'None' to use the built-in sensor.

preset_mode.name: Comfort Mode
preset_mode.description: Select the comfort preset mode (Home, Sleep, Away, or Off).

outside_temperature.name: Outside Temperature
outside_temperature.description: Shows the outside temperature measured by the air conditioner's external sensor.

room_humidity.name: Room Humidity
room_humidity.description: Shows the room humidity level measured by the air conditioner's internal sensor.

manual_override.name: Manual Override
manual_override.description: Indicates when temperature has been manually adjusted away from comfort mode setting

clear_manual_override.name: Clear Manual Override
clear_manual_override.description: Resumes the scheduled preset, clearing any manual temperature override or away mode.

xfan.name: X-Fan
xfan.description: Enables or disables the X-Fan mode for extra drying when turning off.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Controls the display lights on the air conditioner unit.

health.name: Health
health.description: Enables or disables the Health mode for air ionization and purification.

powersave.name: Power Save
powersave.description: Enables or disables the power saving mode for energy efficiency. Only available in cooling mode.

eightdegheat.name: 8°C Heat
eightdegheat.description: Enables or disables the 8°C heating mode for frost protection. Only available in heating mode.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: Enables or disables the sleep mode for comfortable overnight operation. Only available in cooling or heating mode.

air.name: Air
air.description: Enables or disables the fresh air circulation mode.

auto_xfan.name: Auto X-Fan
auto_xfan.description: Automatically controls the X-Fan mode based on HVAC operations. When enabled, X-Fan will automatically turn on in cooling and dry modes.

auto_light.name: Auto Light
auto_light.description: Automatically controls the display lights based on HVAC operations. When enabled, lights will turn on/off with the AC unit.

anti_direct_blow.name: Anti Direct Blow
anti_direct_blow.description: Prevents direct air flow from blowing on people by adjusting the air deflector position.

light_sensor.name: Light Sensor
light_sensor.description: Enables or disables light sensor for automatic brightness. Requires lights to be enabled.

beeper.name: Beeper
beeper.description: Controls the beeper sounds from the air conditioner unit. When enabled, the unit will make sounds for button presses and status changes.

stht_smart.name: Smart 8°C Mode
stht_smart.description: When enabled, automatically activates 8°C frost protection after the Away or Sleep preset has been active in heating mode for the configured threshold. The manual 8°C Heat switch continues to work independently.

schedule_auto_release.name: Auto-Release Override on Preset Change
schedule_auto_release.description: When enabled, a scheduled preset change will automatically clear any active manual override and apply the scheduled preset immediately — as if the 'Clear Override' button were pressed. Default is off, meaning the schedule is silently stored but not applied while an override is active.
